jamie-sre: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we have 4 action items that touch SLOs and dashboards. Need owners + firm dates so we can update SLA docs and alerts.
noah-product: I can own the SLA wording and customer comms. I propose: Hosted p95 target stay at 320ms, add Dedicated p95 = 270ms and a throughput SLO for batch endpoints. I'll draft a PR in 4 days.
maya-oncall: I'll take runbook + failover tests. Plan: add auto-fallback to quantized model when p99 > 1s for 3 minutes; test in staging. Target prototype in 5 days.
venkat-platform: I'll own dashboard changes. Need the exact query for p95/p99 + qps per model variant. Claire, can you add markers?
claire-telemetry: Adding incident markers and a diff view. Dashboard query sketch:
```
select model_variant, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) as p95, quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) as p99, count() as qps from requests where env='prod' and time>now()-1h group by model_variant
```
I'll also schedule a weekly regression run against a short prompt set.
infra-bot: ticket #RWD-4400 created: "SLO + dashboard remediation sprint" assigned to jamie-sre, due 2026-04-15. Link: https://tickets.example/RWD-4400
jamie-sre: Good. Owners: SLA=noah, runbook=maya, dashboard=venkat, telemetry=claire. Acceptance criteria: SLA PR merged, runbook tested in staging, grafana panels live, telemetry job running. Full remediation in 14 days. Schedule a 15-min sync in 48h. :thumbsup:
